coverageLimits: This is the supported local artwork workflow, not full W04 or roadmap completion.
Search is local normalized text and duplicate identity is exact native bytes, not semantic or perceptual similarity.
Native files/packs retain original source metadata and hidden pixels inside captured artwork; they are not redacted publishing outputs.
Library data is local browser storage independent of account identity; removal is logical/reference cleanup, not secure erasure or external backup.
Previews use current browser fonts without embedding. Native decoder/project validation and real browser/storage/memory limits remain; private workers have no strict total heap quota.
The 16 MiB pack manifest and catalog text bounds are metadata budgets, not arbitrary image/file import caps. Originals remain native resolution.
Broad 155/115 results precede the explicitly retained three-module refinement; final 45/5 and cosmetic production/UI checks cover the final changes without claiming identical earlier source bytes.
No paid provider call, source upload, new dependency/permission, document/project/workspace schema change, isolated library grant or REST/browser synchronization was added.
